items.gloss: This set of twenty Prāsādas, Meru and the rest, has been described; he who truly understands them is foremost among architects and much respected by kings. Here ends the appendix portion of chapter 57 of the Samarāṅgaṇasūtradhāra, composed by Mahārājādhirāja Śrī Bhojadeva.
